claims.verbatim:
FARTHER POINT, July 25.—The steamship Hiber-
nian passed this Point this afternoon. She left Liv-
erpool July 16th, direct for Quebec, without stop-
ping at Londonderry. The Hibernian's advices are
one day later.

The steamship Hibernian passed Farther
Point at 3 o'clock yesterday afternoon. She
left Liverpool July 16 at 2 o'clock, direct from
Quebec, without stopping at Londonderry.

claims.verbatim:
The steamship[?] Hibernian, from Liverpool (direct) on
the[?] 16th of July, passed Father Point at half-past three
o'clock yesterday afternoon on her voyage to Quebec.
The Hibernian, after sailing from Londonderry on her
regular day, July 13[?], had to put back for[?] repairs.
The repairs to her screw were finished by Monday
morning, July 16, and she left Liverpool about two
o'clock P. M. the same day for Quebec, without stopping
at Londonderry.
